title: Logitech G102 Gen 2: Why Is This Gaming Mouse Still So Popular?
summary: The Logitech G102 Gen 2 Lightsync is one of the most popular gaming mice around thanks to its accurate sensor, comfortable design, attractive RGB lighting and a price almost any gamer can afford.
description:
## Who is it for?

- FPS players (Valorant, CS2, Apex Legends).
- MOBA players (League of Legends, Dota 2).
- Students who need an all-round mouse for study and play.
- Beginners building their first gaming setup.
- Anyone who wants a quality mouse on a tight budget.

## Why buy it?

- Gaming performance well above its price.
- High accuracy with an 8000 DPI sensor.
- Comfortable design for long sessions.
- Attractive RGB that lifts the look of your setup.
- 24-month official warranty.
- Highly rated by the gaming community for years.

sections.title: Design and grip
sections.content: The Logitech G102 Gen 2 has a simple but effective symmetrical design. At around 85g it is light and easy to control in games that demand fast reflexes, and its medium size suits most hands.

sections.title: Sensor performance
sections.content: The G102's biggest strength is its gaming sensor with up to 8000 DPI. Stable tracking means it handles everything from FPS games to MOBAs and real-time strategy.

sections.title: RGB Lightsync
sections.content: Logitech's RGB Lightsync lets you customise up to 16.8 million colors through the G HUB software. You can sync lighting effects with other Logitech devices for a cohesive setup.

sections.title: Real-world experience
sections.content: In daily use the G102 offers satisfying clicks, fast response and high accuracy. It works well for study, work and gaming alike.

sections.title: Should you buy the Logitech G102 Gen 2 Lightsync?
sections.content: If you are looking for an affordable gaming mouse with steady performance from a trusted brand, the Logitech G102 Gen 2 Lightsync is still one of the best buys today.

pros: 8000 DPI sensor gives high in-game accuracy.
Symmetrical design suits many grip styles.
Powerful, easy-to-use Logitech G HUB software.
Durable switches rated for up to 10 million clicks.
Very competitive price in the gaming segment.
cons: The rubber cable is not very flexible.
No onboard memory for saving profiles.
Fans of heavier mice may not like the 85g weight.
buying_advice: Highly recommended for new gamers and everyday users.

faq.question: Is the Logitech G102 Gen 2 good for Valorant and CS2?
faq.answer: Yes. The 8000 DPI sensor and light weight make it well suited to FPS games that demand high accuracy.

faq.question: Does the Logitech G102 have RGB?
faq.answer: Yes. It has RGB Lightsync with 16.8 million colors and many customisable effects.

faq.question: Is the Logitech G102 Gen 2 suitable for office work?
faq.answer: Yes. Its comfortable design and durability make it work well for both work and entertainment.

seo_title: Logitech G102 Gen 2 Lightsync Review: Still Worth Buying?
seo_description: Review of the Logitech G102 Gen 2 Lightsync with an 8000 DPI sensor, RGB Lightsync, ergonomic design and a 24-month official warranty.
verdict_summary: One of the best-value everyday gaming mice in its price range, with steady performance, attractive RGB and solid durability.
